Portcove 0.1.0-preview.2

First preview of the 0.1.0 beta, published through the new release pipeline. It is for testing installation, built-in updates and save protection before 0.1.0.

## Platforms

- **Windows x86-64:** per-user installer (`Portcove_0.1.0-preview.2_x64-setup.exe`) and the standalone CLI ZIP. These builds are not Authenticode-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC". Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Linux x86-64:** AppImage. Make it executable and run it.
- **macOS (experimental):** universal app. It is not notarized, so macOS blocks the first launch. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and choose **Open Anyway**. macOS has not been tested on physical hardware yet; please report how the first launch goes.

## Updates

Portcove checks for updates itself and installs them only when you choose. Updates are signed, and an update never installs while a game, an install or a backup is running. Portcove follows the **Beta** channel by default, so it moves to 0.1.0 when that is released. To keep receiving previews, choose **Preview** in Settings.

Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS` in this release.
